caption: The black and white drawing displays three views of a single object, which appears to be a three-legged table-like structure. At the top, there is a flat, irregularly triangular slab with three circular marks near each corner. Below this, a side view shows the same slab supported by three legs, each angled outward and ending with flaring bases. A scale bar is depicted centrally beneath the side view. The largest image, at the bottom, presents an isometric view of the object showing the rough texture of the stone-like slab and its three uneven legs. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and black on a plain, off-white background. The name "J. LIPKIN" is inscribed below the object at the bottom.
title: Flat Iron Holder
